description: A patch to fix the broken banner ad task in the Hotline 1.9.2 client
intro:
This repository contains a reproducible binary patch for the PowerPC Classic
Mac version of Hotline 1.9. It replaces the client's defunct ZipAds endpoint
with a configurable plain-HTTP banner URL and fixes the legacy client behavior
that otherwise prevents a direct banner image from loading.

No Hotline application binary is included. You must provide your own copy of
the exact original `HLclient19.Classic` application.
